classifications.rationale: The President presently establishes when the tariff amendments apply to covered articles, directly determining their legal applicability beginning January 1, 1967.
classifications.evidence: the amendments to the Tariff Schedules of the United States made by section 3 (a) of the Joint Resolution shall apply

classifications.rationale: The President designates the United States Information Agency to administer the agreement and assigns it authority to make required determinations and regulations, without dictating their substantive outcomes.
classifications.evidence: the United States Information Agency is hereby designated as the agency to carry out the provisions of the Agreement and related protocol
